title: General Motors, LLC: GM/INLET ELBOW SEPARATION (0 affected)
summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY  RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SAFETY ACT.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.   VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  2001 CHEVROLET AND GMC C-SERIES MEDIUM DUTY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH AN IMPCO LIQUEFIED PETROLEUM GAS (LPG) CONVERSION KIT.  THE ENGINE COULD BACKFIRE CAUSING THE INLET ELBOW TO SEPARATE FROM ITS THROTTLE BODY.

title: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN/BRAKE BOOSTER (345 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES. THE ACCUMULATOR THAT IS INSTALLED ON THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE BOOSTER MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED WHICH, OVER A PERIOD OF TIME, COULD RESULT IN LEAKAGE OF THE PRESSURIZED NITROGEN GAS FROM INSIDE THE ACCUMULATOR.

title: Gulf Stream Coach, Inc.: GULF STREAM/LP GAS TANK BRACKET (272 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTOR HOME CHASSIS.  THE WELDS WHERE THE LIQUID PROPANE (LP) GAS TANK BRACKETING JOINS THE FLOOR TRUSSES MAY NOT BE ADEQUATE.

title: Suburban Manufacturing CO: SUBURBAN/RECREATIONAL VEHICLE FURNACE (3,072 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  RECREATION VEHICLE FURNACE.  SUBURBAN MODEL P-40 (STOCK NUMBER 2230) FURNACES FOR USE IN "PARK MODEL" RECREATION VEHICLES.  THESE UNITS WERE PRODUCED BETWEEN OCTOBER 21, 1999, AND AUGUST 22, 2001 WITH SERIAL NUMBERS FROM 994203292 THROUGH 995006319 AND FROM 000104166 THROUGH 013303226.  THE FANES ON THE DEFECTIVE COMBUSTION AIR BLOWER ARE IMPROPERLY ORIENTED.  THIS RESULTS IN AN INADEQUATE SUPPLY OF COMBUSTION AIR TO THE BURNER IN THE FURNACE WHICH WILL RESULT IN EXCESSIVE CARBON MONOXIDE IN THE FURNACE EXHAUST.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/TRANSMISSION TRANSFER CASE (895 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES (4 WHEEL-DRIVE).   SOME OF THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH A RANGE SHIFT COLLAR IN THE TRANSMISSION TRANSFER CASE THAT CONTAINS CRACKS.

title: NATIONAL R.V. INC.: NATIONAL RV/PINBOX WELD (1,272 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  FIFTH WHEEL TRAILERS.  THE TRAILER PIN BOX STEEL STRUCTURE COULD FAIL AT THE WELDS OR TUBULAR STEEL STRUCTURE DUE TO FATIGUE.

title: U.S. CARGO: US CARGO/DEXTER AXLE/AXLE/BRAKE DRUM (26 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH AMERICAN RACING EQUIPMENT ALUMINUM WHEELS (PART AR-62) COMBINED WITH DEXTER AXLE SIX BOLT HUBS (PART 008-201).   CERTAIN ALUMINUM WHEELS WITH A SMALLER DIAMETER MOUNTING SURFACE ARE NOT ADEQUATELY SUPPORTED WHEN USED ON THE SIX BOLT BRAKE DRUMS.  THE INSUFFICIENT CONTACT AREA BETWEEN THIS WHEEL AND DEXTER'S HUB CAN RESULT IN LOOSENING OF THE WHEEL FASTENERS WHICH COULD CAUSE THE WHEEL(S) TO BECOME DETACHED FROM THE VEHICLE.

title: U.S. BUS CORPORATION: US BUS/FMVSS 221/BUS JOINTS (188 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   CERTAIN SCHOOL BUSES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 221, "SCHOOL BUS BODY JOINT STRENGTH."  THESE BUSES HAVE INSUFFICIENT METAL HEMMING IN THE PANEL JOINTS.

title: COUNTRY COACH INC: COUNTRY COACH/FMVSS 120/TIRE INFLATION PRESSURE (735 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."  THESE MOTOR HOMES WERE ERRONEOUSLY ASSIGNED INADEQUATE TIRE INFLATION PRESSURES AND INADEQUATE AXLE WEIGHT RATINGS ON THE FRONT AND/OR REAR AXLES AS A RESULT OF MATHEMATICAL MISCALCULATIONS.  THESE MOTOR HOMES HAVE TIRE WEIGHT RATINGS THAT ARE LESS THAN THE FRONT OR REAR AXLE WEIGHT RATINGS (FRONT AXLE WEIGHT RATING:FAWR AND REAR AXLE WEIGHT RATINGS:RAWR) AND IN SOME INSTANCES HAVE INADEQUATE FAWR AND/OR RAWR.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: INTERNATIONAL/STEERING SHAFT (242 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS. THE STEERING SHAFTS MAY HAVE A DEFECTIVE OR MIS-LOCATED WELD THAT COULD FAIL.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): DAIMLERCHRYSLER/INSTRUMENT CLUSTER (43,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES ARE BEING RECALLED FOR A SOFTWARE ERROR IN THE INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MICROPROCESSOR.  UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, THE CLUSTER, WITH THE MAJORITY OF ITS GAUGES, ILLUMINATION, AND WARNING LAMPS, COULD BECOME INOPERATIVE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): DAIMLERCHRYSLER/TIRES (151 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN 2500 WAGONS WERE EQUIPPED WITH INCORRECT LOAD RANGE TIRES.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: MERCEDES-BENZ/UPPER CONTROL ARM (870 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES. THE LEFT FRONT UPPER CONTROL ARM MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFIED STRENGTH REQUIREMENTS.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: MONACO/BATTERY CABLE ROUTING (83 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON ROADMASTER CHASSIS.    AS THE RESULT OF THE CLOSE PROXIMITY OF THE ENGINE SYSTEM IN RESPECT TO THE ROUTING OF THE 12-VOLT DC BATTERY CABLES, IT IS POSSIBLE FOR THE INSULATION ON THE BATTERY CABLE TO MELT AND CREATE A SHORT.

title: GENERAL ELECTRIC COMPANY: GE/FMVSS 108/HEADLAMP BULBS (90,098 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  MODEL 9007 AUTOMOTIVE HEADLAMP BULBS, PRODUCT CODES 20551, 22388, 26022, 26141, AND 47642, THAT GE MANUFACTURED BETWEEN FEBRUARY 4 AND MAY 25, 2001.  SOME OF THESE BULBS HAVE PLASTIC BASES WITH A PORTION OF THE MOLDED PLASTIC ALIGNED INCORRECTLY.  THE CONDITION ALLOWS THE BULB TO BE INSTALLED INCORRECTLY IN WHICH, WHEN OPERATED, THE HIGH BEAM WILL SHINE DOWNWARD.  THESE BULBS DO NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: GLOBAL MOTORSPORT GROUP, INC.: GLOBAL MOTORSPORT/4-6 SHIFT CLUTCH (10,000 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  4-6 SHIFT CLUTCH USED IN ITS REVTECH 6-SPEED MOTORCYCLE TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLIES AND 6-SPEED MOTORCYCLE GEARSETS SOLD PRIOR TO SEPTEMBER 12, 2001.  THE 4-6 SHIFT CLUTCH CAN CRACK OR BREAK DURING USE.  THE 4-6 SHIFT CLUTCHES WERE INCLUDED IN THE FOLLOWING REVTECH EQUIPMENT:    6-SPEED GEARSETS NUMBERS:  58345, 58346, 58320, 58339, 58325, AND 58326.  6-SPEED TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLIES NUMBERS:  58340, 58341, 58342, 58343, 58321, 58322, 58323, AND 58324.  6-SPEED BIKE KITS NUMBERS:  95130, 95143, 95144, 95170, 95500, 95501, 95502, 95094, 95090, 95097, 95092, 95115, 95093, 95490, 95491, AND 95492.  6-SPEED DRIVELINE KITS NUMBERS:  58665, 58667, 58695, 58697, 58661, 58663, 58691, 58693, 58613, 58617, 58611, AND 58615.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/WHEEL COVER (396 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:    MOTOR HOMES (MODELS 222FD, 222QD, AND 222HD).  THE WHEEL COVER CAN ROTATE WHILE MOUNTED ON THE WHEEL.

title: MOSS MOTORS, LTD: MOSS MOTORS/JACK (1,500 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  REPLACEMENT AND REPRODUCTION JACKS FOR THE RESTORATION AND MAINTENANCE OF VINTAGE BRITISH CARS.  THE INNER THREADED SHAFT IS SWAGED (MUSHROOMED OUT BY A DROP PUNCH) WHICH LIMITS THE TRAVEL OF THE SHAFT IN ITS THREADS AND HOUSING.  ON SOME JACKS, INSUFFICIENT FOURCE WAS USED TO SWAGE THE SHAFT END ALLOWING THE SHAFT TO COMPLETELY  UNSCREW FROM THE HOUSING.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: KAWASAKI/WIRING HARNESS ROUTING (3,100 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  A SECTION OF THE WIRING HARNESS LOCATED ABOVE THE HEADLIGHT IS ROUTED INCORRECTLY.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/TRW TIE ROD ENDS (20EDL) (75,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH TRW TIE ROD ENDS ON CERTAIN MERITOR AXLES.  THE TIE ROD AND DRAG LINK BALL STUD ENDS CONTAIN BEARINGS THAT ARE BELOW THE SPECIFIED CASE DEPTH AND/OR HARDNESS.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: HARLEY-DAVIDSON/FUEL HOSE (25,711 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  THESE MOTORCYCLES WERE BUILT WITH A FUEL HOSE THAT COULD COME OFF THE CARBURETOR.

title: INDEPENDENCE MOTORCYCLE CO.: FOCUS/INDEPENDENCE/TRANSMISSION (208 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  ON REVTECH 6-SPEED TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLIES AND 6-SPEED GEARSETS, THE 4-6 SHIFT CLUTCH HAS THE POTENTIAL TO FAIL.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: FERRARI/WHEEL BOLT INSERTS (468 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE WHEEL BOLT INSERTS FITTED IN THE MAGNESIUM WHEEL CAN SHOW SIGNS OF CRACKING.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: INTERNATIONAL/FMVSS 121/BRAKE LINE (68 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."  A SECONDARY BRAKE LINE THAT CONNECTS THE FOOT VALVE WITH THE SPRING BRAKE VALVE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.

title: Newmar Corporation: NEWMAR/CARBON MONOXIDE FUMES (31 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON GASOLINE ENGINE CHASSIS.   THERE IS AN IMPROPER SEAL AT THE FRONT DASH AREA ON THE PASSENGER SIDE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: MACK/FRONT SPRINGS (483 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS A HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS WITH 18,000 LB. FRONT AXLES MAY HAVE FRONT SPRINGS INSTALLED THAT ARE RATED FOR THE 14,600 LB. FRONT AXLE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: MACK/TRW TIE ROD ENDS (20EDL) (8,794 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH TRW TIE ROD ENDS ON CERTAIN DANA/SPICER AXLES (E12001) AND MACK AXLES THROUGH DANA HEAVY AXLE (FAWL 12).  THE TIE ROD AND DRAG LINK BALL STUD ENDS CONTAIN BEARINGS THAT ARE BELOW THE SPECIFIED CASE DEPTH AND/OR HARDNESS.

title: WESTPORT AXLE CORP.: WESTPORT AXLE/TRW TIE ROD ENDS (3,910 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  SOME TIE ROD BALL-SOCKET BEARINGS, PART OF TRIE ROD ASSEMBLIES MANUFACTURED BY TRW,  HAVE A BELOW SPECIFICATION CASE DEPTH AND/OR HARDNESS WHICH CAN LEAD TO PREMATURE WEAR OUT OF THE SOCKET IN SOME APPLICATIONS.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/WET BRAKE PERFORMANCE (0 affected)
summary: THIS IS NOT A SAFETY  RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SAFETY ACT.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.   VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  1995-1999 CHEVROLET MONTE CARLO Z34 PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE BRAKING PERFORMANCE IN WET WEATHER OR WET ROAD CONDITIONS IS REDUCED MORE THAN A DRIVER WOULD EXPECT.

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: MITSUBISHI AMERICA/POWER STEERING TUBE (25,803 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   PASSENGER VEHICLES BUILT WITH V6 ENGINES TO FEDERAL EMISSION STANDARDS.  THE POWER STEERING FLUID FEED TUBE CAN COME IN CONTACT WITH AN EXHAUST MANIFOLD MOUNTED HEAT SHIELD CAUSING A HOLE TO BE WORN THROUGH THE POWER STEERING PIPE ALLOWING FLUID LEAKAGE.

title: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN/POWER STEERING TUBE (87 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:    PASSENGER VEHICLES BUILT WITH V6 ENGINES TO FEDERAL EMISSION STANDARDS.  THE POWER STEERING FLUID FEED TUBE CAN COME IN CONTACT WITH AN EXHAUST MANIFOLD MOUNTED HEAT SHIELD CAUSING A HOLE TO BE WORN THROUGH THE POWER STEERING PIPE ALLOWING FLUID LEAKAGE.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: PREVOST/STEERING GEAR BOX SUPPORT (1,153 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTOR HOMES.   THE STEERING GEAR BOX IS MOUNTED ON A SUPPORT LOCATED UNDER THE DRIVER'S SEAT FLOOR.  ON MOTOR HOME MODELS, THIS SUPPORT VARIES IN HEIGHT WITH THE OPTIONAL INTERIOR HEIGHT.  WITH 83 AND 86 INCH HEIGHT OPTIONS, THE SUPPORT MAY BE OVERLOADED IN CERTAIN OPERATION CONDITIONS.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: TOYOTA/AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT (2 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.    INCOMPLETE DEPLOYMENT OF THE FRONT PASSENGER SIDE AIR BAG COULD OCCUR IN THE EVENT OF A CRASH.

title: VAPOR CORPORATION: VAPOR/DOOR PANEL ADHESIVE (40,000 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  ADHESIVELY BONDED ALUMINUM BUS DOOR PANELS USED IN PASSENGER DOORWAYS ON TRANSIT AND LIGHT AND MEDIUM DUTY BUSES INSTALLED ON BUSES BUILT BETWEEN SEPTEMBER 1, 1997, AND FEBRUARY 1, 2000.  DUE TO AN IMPERFECT BONDING OF THE DOOR PANEL SKIN TO THE PANEL FRAME, ENVIRONMENTAL MOISTURE MAY INFILTRATE REGIONS OF IMPERFECT BONDING AND CAUSE SEPARATION OF THE FRAME AND DOOR PANEL.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: PACCAR/KENWORTH/FMVSS 103/DEFOGGING (2,670 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 103, "WINDSHIELD DEFROSTING AND DEFOGGING SYSTEMS."  THE MODE DOOR IN AN HVAC SYSTEM CAN BECOME INOPERABLE.  THE MODE DOOR CAM AND ACTUATOR COULD BIND, CAUSING THE CAM RETAINING TABS TO SHEAR OFF.

title: Hyundai Motor America: HYUNDAI/FMVSS 110/TIRE PRESSURE LABEL (3,255 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 110.   THESE VEHICLES DO NOT HAVE THE CORRECT TIRE PRESSURE PLACARD ATTACHED.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCKS/REPLACEMENT SEAT BELTS (2,277 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AFTERMARKET REPLACEMENT SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES INSTALLED IN THE VOLVO, F7 MODEL, CLASS 7 AND 8 VEHICLES BETWEEN SEPTEMBER 1981 AND MARCH 1986.  THE AFFECTED BELTS CAN BE IDENTIFIED BY PART NUMBER 1088593 OR V1088593.  THESE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES DO NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: CPSC, Oreck Manufacturing Co. Announce the Recall of Certain A/C Adaptors for its ZipVac Hand Held Rechargeable Vacuum
summary: The charger can overheat and melt, presenting a burn or electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: Adaptors for approximately 10,000 vacuums.

title: CPSC, Kids II Announce Recall of Butterfly Baby Toys
summary: The antennae on these butterfly toys contain wire that can pass through the fabric, causing cuts and scratches to babies. Units: About 21,000.

title: CPSC, Racing Champions Ertl, Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Toy Toolboxes
summary: The toy's carrying handle can break, creating small parts and a sharp plastic edge that pose a choking and laceration hazard to young children. Units: About 11,600.

title: CPSC, York International Corporation Announce Recall of Gas Furnaces
summary: York's quality assurance and manufacturing investigation found these furnaces could have detached heat exchanger tubes. A separated heat exchanger tube could result in leakage of flue gases, including carbon monoxide, which could result in serious injury or death. Units: About 7,000.

title: CPSC, Maya Wrap Announce Recall of Infant Carriers/Slings
summary: The welds of the metal rings that support the carriers/slings can break, posing a fall hazard to young children. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Blue Coral Announce Recall of Rain-X® Glass Cleaner and Washer Fluid
summary: The products, which contain methyl alcohol, are not sealed with child-resistant closures, as required by federal law. Methyl alcohol, also known as methanol, is toxic and can cause blindness or death if ingested. Units: About 1.1 million.

title: CPSC, National Service Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Drain Cleaners
summary: The bottles can leak, allowing the contents of the cleaner to come into contact with consumers. These cleaners can cause irritation and burns to the skin and eyes. Units: About 1.1 million.

title: CPSC, TH!NK Mobility Recall Electrically Assisted Bicycles
summary: The top of the handlebar stem binder bolt may twist off, while being tightened. Units: About 200.

title: CPSC, Andersen Corporation Announce Recall of Window Latches
summary: The latches on the lower sash of the window can unexpectedly open, posing a potential injury hazard to consumers who can be struck by the window or by shattered glass. Units: About 400,000.

title: CPSC, Ryobi Technologies Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Circular Saws
summary: The lower blade guards on these saws can stick in the open position, posing a risk of serious injury to the operator and bystanders. Units: About 125,000.

title: CPSC, Hunter's View Ltd. Announce Recall of Hunting Treestands
summary: The cables on these stands can break, causing the treestand to fall to the ground, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 30,000.

title: CPSC, Mill's Pride Announce Recall of Assembled Utility Wall Cabinet
summary: The cabinets can detach from the wall and fall, possibly injuring consumers. Units: About 187,000.

title: CPSC, SBH Restructuring Corp. (formally Storybook Heirlooms) Recall Children's Pajamas
summary: These pajamas fail to meet the Federal Standards for the Flammability of Children's Sleepwear and, as a result, these pajamas pose a risk of injury to children, due to the possible ignition of the garment. Units: About 13,900.

title: CPSC, American Suzuki Motor Corp. Announce Recall of Youth ATVs
summary: The drive chain on these ATVs could come off the sprockets and lock the rear axle. This could cause the driver to lose control of the ATV and crash, possibly resulting in injury or death. Units: About 7,400.

title: CPSC, Maytag Corp. Announce Recall to Repair of Amana Gas Ranges
summary: During the broil and self-clean modes, the range can emit high levels of carbon monoxide (CO), presenting the potential for CO poisoning to consumers.
